entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I hope you can help. I'm just so confused. I have this... uh... VeloBand thing, and it's not working at all. I don't know what to do.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a preference?
Oh, I think it must be a technical fault. It seems broken. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I feel like it's a defective unit.
I see. It's certainly frustrating when a new device doesn't connect properly. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and email address, please?
Of course. It's Alex Chen. a.chen@email.com.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered 38 days ago. I just need to check our policy for you.
38 days? Oh my. I'm not very good with this stuff and I just kept trying to make it work. I'm so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course. And not to worry. Let me see... okay, I've just reviewed our return policy in the system. It states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, really? So I can still return it?
Yes, absolutely. Since you're reporting that the item is defective and you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you.
Oh, wow. That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Diana! I was so worried I was stuck with a broken gadget.

It's my pleasure to help, Alex. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. You've made this so easy. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
